description: Atmos Energy Corporation is a natural gas-only distributor, an S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas and incorporated in Texas and Virginia. It safely delivers reliable, efficient and abundant natural gas through regulated sales and transportation arrangements to approximately 3.4 million residential, commercial, public authority and industrial customers in eight states located primarily in the South, and it also operates one of the largest intrastate pipelines in Texas based on miles of pipe. Its vision is to be the safest provider of natural gas services, and its operating strategy is focused on modernizing its business and infrastructure while reducing regulatory lag, supporting continued investment in safety, innovation, environmental sustainability and its communities.
